---
title: Subpages
layout: docs
---


Sometimes, [like here](docs-shortcodes.html), you want to show a list of the subpages of the page you are on. That is an ordinary markdown list:

```
- [Breadcrumbs](docs-shortcodes-breadcrumbs.html)
- [Button](docs-shortcodes-button.html)
- [Contact buttons](docs-shortcodes-contactbuttons.html)
```

In the documentation section you rarely need it: the `docs` brick already puts the whole tree in the sidebar, built from the pages themselves, and highlights the page you are on.
